items.difficulty_reason: The lemma is the Jordan-Holder theorem: two filtrations of an object of finite length with simple successive quotients have the same length and the same successive quotients up to permutation (statement lines 2259-2272). The proof is a complete argument: a minimality choice identifies the first simple quotient of one filtration with a quotient of the other (proof lines 2275-2277), and after passing to the quotient by the first step the two filtrations are compared by induction (proof lines 2278-2288). The non-formal content is the construction of the two induced filtrations on the quotient. The claim is H2: a structured argument with each input named.
